payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW ran through agent_lane converge with one lane (claude_code, quorum 1 by cloud-container policy). The first lane run raised two medium spec gaps in design.md (missing approver on policy waivers; undefined handling of a stored verdict that fails the predicate) and one accepted low (trailer identity is advisory). Both medium gaps were fixed in commit f1487fc, but the first lane aborted on a scope check that counted the then-uncommitted loop-state.json as a fix edit. A restarted lane re-dispatched item 1 from the persisted ledger after its fix had already landed, so the ledger recorded the fix as not touching its file and the loop stalled after 2 rounds. Outcome not_converged routes to PLAN_FIX.
completed_work: design.md D3: stored verdict used only when the predicate passes against live state, else fresh dispatch
design.md D4: approver required on both waiver sources; policy approver is policy:merge-pull-requests; eligibility_reason semantics defined

decisions.title: Commit loop-state.json before each review lane run
decisions.rationale: The fix-scope diff runs against the working tree, so a dirty loop-state.json is attributed to the fix and rejected as out of scope.

next_steps: PLAN_FIX: confirm f1487fc addresses ledger item 1
